name: antibot-bestbuy-title
instruction: Extract the page title and two top-level shopping category names from the site navigation. Return JSON: { "title": string, "categories": string[] }
successCheckSrc: r=>{const t=findStr(r.data,'best buy');return t?{success:true,reason:'has bestbuy title/content'}:{success:false,reason:'no bestbuy content'}}

name: antibot-nike-categories
instruction: Extract two product category names shown in the top navigation (for example Men, Women, Kids, or Jordan). Return JSON: { "categories": string[] }
successCheckSrc: r=>{const a=findArray(r.data);const ok=a&&a.filter(x=>typeof x==='string'&&x.length>1).length>=2;const kw=findStr(r.data,'men')||findStr(r.data,'jordan')||findStr(r.data,'kids')||findStr(r.data,'women');return (ok&&kw)?{success:true,reason:'>=2 nav categories'}:{success:false,reason:'no category array'}}

name: multistep-imdb-inception
instruction: Search for the movie 'Inception' (the 2010 film), open its page, and extract its director and release year. Return JSON: { "director": string, "year": string }

name: multistep-github-react-stars
instruction: Navigate to the facebook/react repository and extract its primary programming language and its star count. Return JSON: { "language": string, "stars": number }
successCheckSrc: r=>{const lang=findStr(r.data,'javascript')||findStr(r.data,'typescript');const n=findValue(r.data,v=>typeof v==='number'&&v>150000)||findValue(r.data,v=>typeof v==='string'&&/2[0-9]{2}[.,]?[0-9]*k/i.test(v));return (lang&&n)?{success:true,reason:'language + >150k stars'}:{success:false,reason:'missing lang or stars'}}
